# tools/list budget

<!-- Generated by `python -m hocuspocus.tools.docs --budget`, which appends a dated row to the history on every run. Do not edit by hand. -->

Bytes of the serialised `tools/list` result the bridge sends (compact JSON, as the MCP SDK writes it), per profile and `result_content` mode (BIBLE §4.1, spec-2.0 §5.1). `text` is what clients see by default (no output schemas); `both` declares them. Caps on the full profile: `text` ≤ 32,000 B, `both` ≤ 44,000 B. `v2` (full plus the 2.0 tools, spec-2.0 §7 M1) is measured but has no cap of its own; rows from before it show `—` there. A change that raises a number says why in its commit.
